verdict.rationale: Docs confirm metadata filtering can be combined with full-text/document search ($contains, $regex, $not_contains) via .get/.query, but the evidence pack never documents range operators, geo filters, nested AND/OR boolean logic, or array membership ($in) operators explicitly. missing for 10: range query operators, geo filtering, nested boolean logic (AND/OR), array membership operators, and independent confirmation of these advanced filter semantics.
